Definition: a prolonged form for G5275; to leave behind, i.e. bequeath:--leave.
BiblicalUsage: The word hypolimpánō carries the sense of to leave behind, to bequeath. In 1 Peter 2:21, the text says "leaving us an example."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hypolimpánō means to leave behind, to bequeath, and I leave it at that.
